captions.detailed: A compact, desktop-style cylindrical air purifier in a matte dark gray finish. It features a top-mounted recessed outlet grille with parallel ventilation slats. A rectangular front-access filter door with a small, knurled metallic pull tab on its left edge is mounted flush against the curved main body, swinging outward on a right-side vertical hinge axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact desktop air purifier with a cylindrical main body and a recessed top outlet grille. Add an articulated rectangular filter door on the front that swings outward on a vertical hinge, complete with a small knurled pull tab on its opening edge.
captions.factory: The code constructs the air purifier by first modeling the main body as a cylinder, hollowed out at the top to form a recessed grille area using boolean subtractions, and adding parallel slats. A rectangular cutout is carved from the front face to create the filter bay. The filter door is modeled as a separate curved-front panel with hinge barrels and a knurled pull tab, then connected to the main body via a revolute joint to simulate the outward swing.
